items.author: niT-Tin
items.descZh: oz 是一款使用 Zig 语言编写的个人终端文本编辑器，定位为 Vim 的功能子集并融入了大量现代化的插件增强，旨在为开发者打造轻量且高度可定制的编辑核心。核心功能上，它完整支持 Vim 六种编辑模式、多光标操作、键盘宏录制与播放，并提供了带有分支语义的撤销重做和系统剪贴板交互。亮点在于其基于 Tree-sitter 的实时语法高亮、彩虹括号和内联 Markdown 渲染，且在大文件处理上表现优异，超过 100 KB 时会自动关闭高亮以确保流畅运行。编辑器还内置了异步 LSP 支持（不阻塞启动）、模糊搜索选择器以及类似 DoomEmacs 的多工作区管理，适合复杂项目开发。它特别适用于既追求 Vim 式高效键盘操作，又需要现代 IDE 级别智能提示和项目工作区隔离的开发者日常编码与文本处理场景。
items.quote: 一款个人文本编辑器，基于 Vim 的子集构建，并带有额外的插件增强功能。

"pyproject.toml") [pyproject.toml](/omarirfa/Rideshare%5Fmarket/blob/master/pyproject.toml "pyproject.toml") View all files Repository files navigation NYC airport ridehail Anyone who wants to know how the airport ridehail market in New York City (NYC) really works runs into the same wall: the regulator publishes about 40 gigabytes of raw trip records, and nobody publishes an airport summary. This project turns those records into an interactive notebook. It keeps the 122,806,218 trips that touch John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK), LaGuardia Airport (LGA) or Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) between February 2019 and June 2026, and it answers the market questions from the trips themselves rather than from a press release. One marimo notebook holds the whole pipeline: the download, the transform, the storage layer, the analysis and the conclusions. You can see the static html site here: <https://nycridesharestatic.omarirfan.workers.dev/ What the data says Riders pay more, drivers keep less. The median airport fare rose 52.1% across the archive while the median driver gross rose 34.3%. Payout share fell from 69.7% to 63.9%. Median trip distance barely moved, so trip mix does not explain the gap. Paying drivers more did not buy market share. Lyft's payout share overtook Uber's at JFK in 2023 and has stayed above it, while Lyft's share of trips fell. That points away from pay as the binding constraint and toward matching, dispatch and curb operations. The two airports are different products. Over the last ten months, Uber's median fare at LaGuardia runs $7.45 above Lyft's on an identical 9.5mile median, a 15.3% gap. At JFK the gap is 3.5% and runs the other way. A single networkwide target misreads one of them. A reporting rule, not a product change. Onscene coverage for one platform goes from 0.16% in February 2025 to 85.6% in March and 100% in April. TLC's Wait Time Restrictions rule took effect on 6 March 2025\. Curb wait is only comparable from that month. Driver pay above rider payment is the minimumpay floor, not incentive spend. New York's formula pays by mile and minute divided by a utilization rate, independent of the fare, so on lowfare airport trips the floor lands above what the rider paid. Two questions the data cannot answer. There is no driver identifier, so no segmentation. There are no cancelled trips, so no cancellation rate. Section 8 says so rather than building a proxy. Demo [](/omarirfa/Rideshare%5Fmarket/blob/master/docs/graph%5Fdemo.gif) [](/omarirfa/Rideshare%5Fmarket/blob/master/docs/notebook%5Fscreenshot.png) Quick start uv run marimo edit nyc_airports.py The notebook carries PEP 723 inline metadata, so uv builds the environment from the file itself. Without uv: pip install e ".[dev]" marimo edit nyc_airports.py Libraries used [altair](https://github.com/vega/altair) \ every chart, through one registered theme. [marimo](https://github.com/marimoteam/marimo) \ the reactive notebook this file runs in. [orjson](https://github.com/ijl/orjson) \ reads and writes the cached download headers. [polars](https://github.com/polars/polars) \ every scan, filter and aggregate. [pygwalker](https://github.com/Kanaries/pygwalker) \ the draganddrop exploration views. items.author: fl4res
items.descZh: 本项目针对纽约三大机场（JFK、LGA、EWR）网约车数据碎片化、缺乏系统性汇总的痛点，将约40GB的原始出行记录转化为交互式分析笔记本，梳理了2019年2月至2026年6月期间的1.2亿余条出行数据。整个分析流程集成在单个基于 Python 的 marimo 交互式笔记本中，利用 polars 进行高效数据处理，并通过 altair 和 pygwalker 提供丰富的拖拽式探索和可视化功能。核心亮点在于用数据揭示了市场深层机制：中位数机场票价上涨了52.1%，而司机分成比例从69.7%降至63.9%，且平台派单与现场运营策略（如某平台覆盖率从0.16%飙升至100%）对市场格局的影响远大于司机薪酬激励。此外，分析精确指出了不同机场的产品差异，例如在拉瓜迪亚机场（LGA）Uber与Lyft的中位数票价存在15.3%的巨大差距。该工具及生成的静态报告适用于城市交通研究人员、政策制定者和平台运营者，用于评估监管政策（如最低工资和等待时间限制）对机场网约车市场的实际冲击。

some powerups for extra variety. It is recommended to use a [Nerd Font](https://www.nerdfonts.com/) so that all text renders correctly. This is my first Rust project I built this mainly to learn Rust, so the implementation is pretty basic. [Blog post](https://orangishcat.dev/blog/cursedtetris) Star the repo if you liked the game [](/orangishcat/cursedtetris/blob/main/title.png) [](/orangishcat/cursedtetris/blob/main/gameplay.png) Play online 1. Generate an SSH key if you don't have one already, using sshkeygen 2. ssh play@cursedtetris.orangishcat.dev; your SSH key is your identity. Server may or may not be online, or full, or whatever. No guarantees; I'm not very good with server infrastructure. You can always play offline. Note: Maximize your terminal when running the program Download instructions (for playing offline) Linux/MacOS For MacOS, only Apple Silicon is supported as of right now 1. Download the Linux or MacOS build of the [latest release](https://github.com/orangishcat/cursedtetris/releases/latest) 2. Extract the tarball. 3. Open the terminal and change directory into the extracted directory using cd. 4. Run ./cursedtetris from the command line. (On MacOS, you may need to unquarantine and/or selfsign the binary first.) Windows 1. Download the Windows exe of the [latest release](https://github.com/orangishcat/cursedtetris/releases/latest). 2. Extract the zip and navigate into the extracted folder. 3. Double click the .exe/application. Selfhosting the online leaderboard Run the game with a shared SQLite database and a stable player ID to enable the online leaderboard: cursedtetris online /var/lib/cursedtetris/scores.sqlite3 id PLAYER_ID Both options are required together. For SSH hosting, the forcedcommand launcher should derive PLAYER_ID from the authenticated public key. The ID is private to the database; players choose a display name when they first submit a qualifying score. items.descZh: Cursed Tetris 是一个由 orangishcat 开发的终端俄罗斯方块游戏，使用 Rust 语言编写，旨在作为学习 Rust 的实践项目，实现较为基础。游戏核心功能包括经典的俄罗斯方块玩法，并加入了一些 powerups 以增加多样性，支持通过 SSH 在线游玩或离线体验，同时提供基于 SQLite 数据库的在线排行榜功能。亮点在于使用了 Ratatui 和 Crossterm 库构建终端界面，确保文本渲染流畅（建议使用 Nerd Font），并实现跨平台支持（Linux、MacOS 仅限 Apple Silicon、Windows），但原文未提及具体性能数字如帧率或响应速度。适用场景包括喜欢终端游戏、学习 Rust 编程或寻找休闲俄罗斯方块体验的用户，可通过下载二进制文件或 SSH 连接进行游戏。

items.descZh: 在AI代理深度参与软件开发的趋势下，传统版本控制系统难以追踪和可视化AI所做变更的复杂影响。firelockai/kin定位为AI编写软件的记录系统，通过构建实体、关系、变更和来源的持久图谱，让人类和AI在合并前清晰感知变更的影响范围。它作为Git的补充工具，提供细粒度的变更追溯能力，并支持多种主流AI编程插件，如Claude和Cursor。该项目已在GitHub上积累近3000次提交，显示出高度的活跃度和社区参与。适用于依赖AI代理进行大规模代码生成与修改的团队，旨在提升变更质量和协作效率。
